zh-CN.name: 用户行为分析
zh-CN.description: 围绕用户操作路径、事件、群组和任务结果分析产品使用情况。事件记录、热区或漏斗并不能直接解释用户为什么行动，需要结合定义、隐私边界与其他研究。
use_when: 希望找出任务路径中的流失或操作阻碍。
事件定义与数据采集范围透明且合适。
avoid_when: 不能将点击行为直接当作心理动机。
不要默认采集敏感输入或可识别个人数据。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
按用户任务展示事件路径和漏斗，说明事件定义、时间范围与样本；区分观察事实与原因假设，提供群组比较和数据缺失提示；减少个人可识别信息，仅显示任务必要的数据。
专属演示：示例访问、探索和完成的漏斗与路径视图，切换视图保留统一样本说明。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: User Behavior Analytics
en.description: Analyzing product use through action paths, events, cohorts and task outcomes. Events, heatmaps and funnels do not directly explain user motivation; interpretation needs clear definitions, privacy boundaries and complementary research.
use_when: The team needs to identify drop-off or friction within task paths.
Event definitions and data collection boundaries are transparent and appropriate.
avoid_when: Do not treat click behavior as direct evidence of motivation.
Do not collect sensitive input or identifiable personal data by default.
en.prompt_template:
Show event paths and funnels organized by user task, with event definitions, time ranges and sample information. Distinguish observations from causal hypotheses, support cohort comparison, and disclose missing data. Minimize identifiable information and show only task-relevant data.
Dedicated demonstration: A sample visit/explore/complete funnel and path view; switching views retains the sample explanation. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px.
